description: The nightly's full run is in a canary, `v1.63.0-next-canary-20260708115118-noble` — a tag the registry really carries, for a build from before 1.63.0 shipped, and it begins with exactly the release's tag. A reader that took the version off the front, or compared with `startsWith`, would read 1.63.0 here and pass. It is the FIRST mention in the LAST file, the flake job below it at the right tag, so a reader that stopped at the first file or took the last mention of each would pass it too.

workflows..github/workflows/nightly.yml:
jobs:
  full:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-next-canary-20260708115118-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx run-many -t e2e
  flake:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
